name: Should I finish my basement or build an exterior room addition for more living space?

mainEntity.name: Should I finish my basement or build an exterior room addition for more living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement finishes and additions differ significantly in cost, permitting complexity, and structural requirements. Finishing an existing basement uses your home's current footprint and foundation, making it a faster, more budget-friendly way to add bedrooms, entertainment rooms, or bathrooms without outdoor disruption. A room addition expands your home outward or upward, requiring extensive excavation, foundation pouring, exterior roofing, and exterior siding. If you want added square footage at a lower cost per square foot, finishing the basement is typically the smarter path.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finishing a basement is faster and more cost-effective because the foundation and framing exist, whereas additions require new foundations, roofing, and exterior work.
